record_scope_reconstruction: Separate July 7–9 and July 11, 2025 phases at the Mexican entrance to the Reynosa–Pharr road crossing obstructed US-bound traffic. July 11 commercial circulation returned at 14:30; July 7 staff closed entry gates as demonstrators arrived. The Victoria–Matamoros/La Y blockade mentioned in the same article is a distinct domestic site.

source_checks.finding: Full N+ July 11 report inspected: renewed blockade toward the US and later reopening; transporters resisted being stranded.
Full Hora Cero July 11 report inspected: commercial traffic resumed at 14:30 after over four hours.
Full NotiGAPE July 11 report inspected: second action that week at Pharr and freight could not reach customs.
Full July 7 N+ report inspected: bridge administration shut gates at protest arrival; US-bound freight stranded. Separate La Y domestic road action not assigned to Pharr.
Direct OSM Mexican approach and named toll plaza inspected; full bridge mean rejected because it lies far north of Mexican entrance.
